# Manual Test Cases — JubileeVerse.com (incl. Radio)

**Total:** 288 cases   |   **Generated by:** `qa/build-catalog.js`

_Filtered view of_ `TEST-CASE-CATALOG.csv` _showing only cases that require human execution._

These cases need a human at a browser, mobile device, or with credentials/data
that automation alone cannot exercise. Examples: pointer drag interactions,
mobile share-sheet, real audio playback, visual review, on-device behaviour.

**Two sub-categories:**
- _Partial_ — Playwright already covers the static / HTTP / DOM-presence part; a human still verifies the interactive or visual aspect.
- _Manual only_ — No automation planned in current phases; pure human work.

**How to run:** open `MANUAL-TEST-CASES.csv` in Excel, filter to the module / priority you own, follow each case's `Preconditions` + `TestSteps` against the target environment.

**Recommended cadence:**
- _P0 + P1 cases_ — every release-candidate cycle (~3 h focused testing).
- _P2 cases_ — minor releases.
- _P3 cases_ — major releases.

**For the automated counterpart, see** [`AUTOMATED-TEST-CASES.md`](AUTOMATED-TEST-CASES.md).
